name: Mercure Samarinda
short_description: A 139-room, 4-star riverside hotel in central Samarinda with Mahakam River views, a rooftop pool, and direct access to City Centrum mall.
ai_summary: Mercure Samarinda was the first Accor hotel to open in the East Kalimantan capital, standing beside its sister property ibis Samarinda in the city center with views over the Mahakam River. The 139-room hotel offers Superior, Deluxe, Deluxe Suite, and Executive Suite categories, a rooftop pool, fitness center, and Samarinda's largest ballroom with capacity for 1,500 guests across 2,350 square meters of event space. Guests consistently praise cleanliness, breakfast, and staff service, with direct mall access and river views as recurring highlights; some reviews note the property could use refreshing in places typical of an established city hotel.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Samarinda the same building as ibis Samarinda?
faqs.answer: No -- they are two separate but adjacent buildings under the same ownership, opened together in 2020 and connected by shared facilities including the outdoor pool area. Mercure is the more upscale of the pair, with larger rooms and suite categories, while ibis Samarinda next door is the budget-oriented option.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Samarinda have river views?
faqs.answer: Yes -- many rooms and the rooftop Skyhouse Restaurant & Bar look out over the Mahakam River, which runs through central Samarinda. The hotel markets its panoramic river and city views as one of its main draws, alongside its direct connection to City Centrum mall next door.
